Name: (CP) GelatinousCubes
Author: LilithielGames

[center][size=4][b](CP) GelatinousCubes[/b] changes standard gumdrop shaped Slimes to square ooze cubes. [/size][size=3][img]https://i.giphy.com/media/cqNXRKxWhTHgEa64KI/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img][/size][/center][center][i]Like your favourite Tabletop RPG monster! Only without the Engulf and Pseudopod actions.[/i][/center]
[size=3][b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Extract (CP) GelatinousCubes.zip into your Stardew Valley mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Delve into a slimy habitat.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy awkwardly pixelated oozy gelatinous cubes instead of cheerful gumdrop slimes.[/size]
[/list]
